1.w: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

2.w: “Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: I [am] YHWH your⁺ God.

3.w: You⁺ shall not do according to the work of the land of Egypt in which you⁺ dwelt, and according to the work of the land of Canaan where I am bringing you⁺, you⁺ shall not do, and in their statutes you⁺ shall not walk.

4.w: You⁺ shall do My judgments, and you⁺ shall keep My statutes, to walk in them. I [am] YHWH your⁺ God.

5.w: And you⁺ shall keep My statutes and My judgments, which the man shall do them, and he shall live by them. I [am] YHWH.

6.w: Any man shall not draw near to any close relative of his flesh to uncover nakedness. I [am] YHWH.

7.w: The nakedness of your father and the nakedness of your mother you shall not uncover. She [is] your mother; you shall not uncover her nakedness.

8.w: The nakedness of the wife of your father you shall not uncover; it [is] the nakedness of your father.

9.w: The nakedness of your sister the daughter of your father or the daughter of your mother born [at] home or born outside [it], you shall not uncover their nakedness.

10.w: The nakedness of the daughter of your son or of the daughter of your daughter—you shall not uncover their nakedness; for they [are] your own nakedness.

11.w: The nakedness of the daughter of the wife of your father, begotten of your father—she [is] your sister—you shall not uncover her nakedness.

12.w: The nakedness of the sister of your father you shall not uncover; she [is] a close relative of your father.

13.w: The nakedness of the sister of your mother you shall not uncover, for she [is] a close relative of your mother.

14.w: The nakedness of the brother of your father you shall not uncover. To his wife you shall not draw near; she [is] your aunt.

15.w: The nakedness of your daughter-in-law you shall not uncover; she [is] the wife of your son. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

16.w: The nakedness of the wife of your brother you shall not uncover; it [is] the nakedness of your brother.

17.w: The nakedness of a woman and her daughter you shall not uncover—the daughter of her son and the daughter of her daughter you shall not take to uncover her nakedness. They [are] close relatives; it [is] wickedness.

18.w: And a woman to her sister you shall not take, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness beside her in her life.

19.w: And to a woman in the menstruation of her uncleanness you shall not draw near to uncover her nakedness.

20.w: And to the wife of your neighbor you shall not give your lying to seed to defile yourself with her.

21.w: And from your seed you shall not give to pass over to Molech, and you shall not profane the name of your God. I [am] YHWH.

22.w: And with a male you shall not lie the lyings of a woman; it [is] an abomination.

23.w: And with any animal you shall not give your lyings to defile yourself with it, and a woman shall not stand before the face of an animal to lie with it. It [is] perversion.

24.w: Do not defile yourselves with any of these things, for by all these the nations have defiled themselves, which I [am] sending away from before your⁺ faces.

25.w: And the land is defiled; and I visit the punishment of its iniquity upon it, and the land vomits out those dwelling in it.

26.w: And you⁺ shall keep My statutes and My judgments, and you⁺ shall not do from all of these abominations, the native and the sojourner who is sojourning in your⁺ midst—

27.w: for the men of the land who [were] before your⁺ faces have done all these abominations, and the land was defiled—

28.w: And the land will not vomit you⁺ out when you⁺ defile it, as it vomited out the nation that [was] before your⁺ faces.

29.w: For anyone who does from all these abominations—then the soul who do [them]—shall be cut off from among their people.

30.w: And you⁺ shall keep My charge, to not do from the statutes of the abominations that have been done before your⁺ faces, and you⁺ shall not defile yourselves by them. I [am] YHWH your⁺ God.”
